title: sources/<source>.yaml
description: One data source: its dialect, how to connect and which tables are in scope.

source.description: Source name. Equals the file name.

dialect.description: SQL dialect. Only duckdb and postgres run queries directly; the others use the query-plan protocol.

connection.description: How to connect. Never holds a URL or a secret.

env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the connection URL; never the URL itself.

database.description: DuckDB only: ":memory:" or a .duckdb file path relative to the semantic root.

setup.description: DuckDB only: statements run on every connection, in order.

views.description: DuckDB only: view name to relation, such as read_parquet('../data/x/*.parquet'). Relative paths resolve from the semantic root.

scope.description: Which tables are in scope. Exclude wins over include.

include.description: Patterns a table must match one of; empty or absent includes every table. Globs with * and ?, or re:<regex>; a dot matches schema.table.

exclude.description: Patterns that remove a table from scope.

sample_rows.description: Profile over a sample of this many rows when a table is larger; omit for full scans.

top_values.description: How many most frequent values to keep per column.

draft.description: Settings sl draft remembers for this source.

strip_prefixes.description: Prefixes removed from table names to form model names, such as fct_ and dim_.
